content.short: Multichain quest platform with daily GM streaks, mystery box rewards, domains and NFT mints.
content.description: coNFT, from CoLabs, rewards users for being active across newer chains. Players complete quests and GM streaks on networks such as Soneium, Monad and Robinhood Chain to collect mystery boxes, mint on-chain pets and badges, and claim domain names. The same team runs CoBridge, the CoPump memecoin launchpad, Faucet3 and CoPass for proof-of-humanity scores.
content.meta: Complete quests and GM streaks on new chains with coNFT to earn mystery boxes, badges and on-chain domains.
